question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

How long have you been ________ these contact lenses?
solution:
The correct answer is '**wearing**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**wearing**" means to have something on your body as clothing, accessories, or in this case, contact lenses. (पहनना)
 
• The sentence asks about the duration of time the person has been using contact lenses, which makes "**wearing**" the most appropriate choice.
 
• Other options like "**swimming**," "**prevailing**," and "**seeing**" do not fit the context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *How long have you been wearing__ these contact lenses?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Swimming (तैराकी)**: refers to the activity of moving through water.
 
• **Prevailing (प्रचलित)**: means existing at a particular time or being widespread.
 
• **Seeing (देखना)**: refers to perceiving with the eyes.
